title: Supply of Solar Panels and Accessories for Dhanushkodi Lighthouse
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for supply of two 385 W solar panels, MPPT charge controllers, pure sine wave inverters, DC/AC distribution boxes and cabling for Dhanushkodi Lighthouse, Tamil Nadu, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Dhanushkodi Lighthouse, Dhanushkodi Post, Rameswaram Taluk, Ramanathapuram Dist.
sites.work: Supply of solar panels and accessories

scope.item: 385 W IP68 monocrystalline solar panel, 48 V Voc / 10.2 A Isc, approx. 1968 x 987 x 40 mm, junction box with MC4 connector
Wall mounting MPPT solar charge controller 24 V/60 A for 24 V battery bank, PV range 70-150 V Voc, max 1200 W, digital display
24 V / 1400 W or above pure sine wave inverter with high efficiency copper coiled transformer
IP67 DCDB box with transparent cover, single string 600 V/3 kW SPD and 500 V/25 A DP DC MCB
IP67 ACDB box with transparent cover, single phase DP SPD and 500 V/10 A DP AC MCB
6 sq.mm tin coated DC cable from solar panel to DCDB
Packing and transportation charges to Dhanushkodi Lighthouse

money.notes: No estimate or EMD printed. GST paid as per actual. 100% payment after receipt of items in good condition.

period.completion: Supply within 30 days from acceptance of purchase order
period.warranty: 60 months (5 years from date of supply)

eligibility: Reputed firms or authorised dealers/agents; credentials and descriptive brochures to accompany quotation
specs: 385 W IP68 mono PERC-class panels 48 V Voc/10.2 A Isc; MPPT 24 V/60 A controller; 24 V 1400 W pure sine inverter; IP67 DCDB/ACDB with SPD and MCBs; tin coated DC cables
Items to conform to BIS wherever applicable
notes: Scanned NIQ: notice, Annexure A schedule (rates blank) and Annexure B terms. Quotations due 19.09.2022 15:00, opened 16:00 same day.
